snapshot_replay_limit: Refreshed DB and temporary input tar copies removed. Exact future replay needs the same DB bytes; image IDs and raw-input hashes remain.
test_image_context_limit: The first bare scanned test-image regression failed four M7 integrity cases because Windows checkout changed LF to CRLF. The accepted regression uses the same immutable scanned image ID with the four committed Git-LF pilot files mounted read-only. Code, tests, labels, observations, splits and hash validation are unchanged. Final CI builds use the LF checkout policy and later docs/JSON inputs; byte identity with the scanned test image is not claimed.

bare_image_regression_failure.cause: Windows checkout CRLF bytes in M7 pilot artifacts differ from committed LF bytes; hash validator rejects

earlier_failed_campaign_host_resource_ob.context: Read-only observation during DB warmup; host resource pressure, no performance ranking

host_maintenance: Inert tools and input archives from earlier campaigns were NTFS-compressed with before/after SHA256 equality to preserve disk space; current input files and historical DB untouched. No scanner timing ranking claimed.

second_scan_failure.reason: Java index DB absent; offline skip-update correctly refused first use

third_scan_failure.diagnosis: Syft RPM rows also include elf-binary-package-note-json-payload metadata without version/release fields; package top-level version contains EVR
